title: An icon drawn in a frame exports as a still picture instead of an animated SVG
goal: Draw an icon inside an icon frame, give something in it a motion, and export it as an Animated SVG: the file that comes out is one still photograph of the icon with no animation in it at all. The tutorials tell you to start on an icon frame and then to export an animated SVG, so following both in order hands you a file that does not move. The Export sheet warns that the frame rides along as a picture but never says the motion was thrown away.
acceptance: An icon drawn inside an icon frame, with one piece of it moving, exports as an Animated SVG that moves when opened in a browser
That file carries no embedded picture when everything in the frame is shapes
Anything the file still cannot carry is named in the Export sheet before you save
A test exports a frame holding a moving piece and asserts the written file has animation elements in it
